note: Quay County (NM) publishes no queryable zoning district layer. Its only zoning attributes are in the statewide parcel layers (Quay = layer 20, fields ZoningCode/ZoningDescription), but the state MapServer answers 'not started' / 'not found' and the hosted FeatureServer requires a token. The county GIS page links only to an Experience Builder assessor viewer. Tucumcari, Logan and House publish no zoning GIS layer found in search; Tucumcari's zone map is a document only.
